app.title: Babsha
app.buildStatus: Sprint 0 scaffold. Nothing is playable yet.
card.lucky_01: The Metro Rail gets you across the city in minutes. Advance to {tile}. Collect {salary} if you pass GO.
card.lucky_02: Your CNG driver agrees to go by the meter. Advance to {tile} and collect {salary}.
card.lucky_03: The road is dug up again for a new drain. Go back {steps} tiles.
card.lucky_04: Your bus joins a three-hour tailback. Go directly to Jam. Do not pass GO, do not collect {salary}.
card.lucky_05: Load-shedding ends early and the shop fridge saves your stock. Collect {amount}.
card.lucky_06: Knee-deep water after the rain. Pay {amount} for a van ride to the main road.
card.lucky_07: Your alpona design wins a prize at the Pohela Boishakh fair. Collect {amount}.
card.lucky_08: The Eid shopping list grew longer at every shop. Pay {amount}.
card.lucky_09: Your first book sells out at Boi Mela. Collect {amount}.
card.lucky_10: A rickshaw puller knows every back lane. Keep this card and use it to leave Jam for free.
card.lucky_11: Monsoon rain finds every leak in the roof. Pay {perHouse} per house and {perHotel} per hotel.
card.lucky_12: You catch the evening launch. Advance to {tile}. Collect {salary} if you pass GO.
card.lucky_13: Friends invite you to fly kites at Shakrain. Advance to {tile}. Collect {salary} if you pass GO.
card.lucky_14: Rain sends ride app fares sky high. Pay {amount}.
card.lucky_15: A relative flies home from abroad and you go to pick them up. Advance to {tile}. Collect {salary} if you pass GO.
card.lucky_16: You find your lost Metro Rail card with credit still on it. Collect {amount}.
card.dohs_01: The society meeting ends early. Advance to {tile} and collect {salary}.
card.dohs_02: Your old savings certificate matures. Collect {amount}.
card.dohs_03: The society maintenance fee is due. Pay {amount}.
card.dohs_04: Your generator kept the whole building's fans running through load-shedding. Collect {amount} from each player.
card.dohs_05: You treat everyone to tea and singara at the corner stall. Pay each player {amount}.
card.dohs_06: A neighbor lends you a motorbike. Keep this card and use it to leave Jam for free.
card.dohs_07: The only road out of your lane is closed for construction. Go directly to Jam. Do not pass GO, do not collect {salary}.
card.dohs_08: Your festival bonus arrives before Eid. Collect {amount}.
card.dohs_09: Your IPS battery gives up halfway through load-shedding. Pay {amount} for a new one.
card.dohs_10: Mangoes from your rooftop garden sell out at the bazar. Collect {amount}.
card.dohs_11: The AC worked overtime all summer. Pay {amount} on the electricity bill.
card.dohs_12: You host a Pohela Boishakh breakfast of panta and ilish. Pay {amount}.
card.dohs_13: The society repaints every building after the monsoon. Pay {perHouse} per house and {perHotel} per hotel.
card.dohs_14: Your kite wins the rooftop kite contest. Collect {amount}.
card.dohs_15: You tutor a neighbor's child through exam season. Collect {amount}.
card.dohs_16: A morning walk by the lake sounds perfect. Advance to {tile}. Collect {salary} if you pass GO.
